recipe.name: flan
steps: Add sugar to medium saucepan heated to meduim, along with water. Stir frequently until sugar is dissolved (around 2 minutes)
Increase heat to medium-high and wait until it is golden or amber in color, stirring occasionally.
Pour into an 8in round cake pan, tilt and rotate until caramel has spread to all portions of the bottom. Set aside to cool.
Combine eggs, condensed milk, evaporated milk, and vanilla extract in blender or whisk in bowl till combined. Pour through Sieve to remove bubbles.
Take cooled cake pan and set onto roasting pan or baking dish, and pour milk mixture into it gently. Fill pan or dish with an inch of water.
Transfer to oven and bake for 35-40 minutes, until center is just set (flan should wobble slightly when wiggled)
Remove from oven and set cake pan on wire rack to cool to room temperature, then set in refridgerator to cool fully.
After 1 to 2 hours, flan should be cooled. Serve and enjoy within the next few days.
